next.reason: 1985: the report footing is processed 'only once per report and as the last report group of that report ... during the execution of a corresponding TERMINATE statement, if there has been at least one GENERATE statement executed for that report'. 2023: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR6 g) 'The report footing, if defined, is printed, as the very last report group in the report, when a TERMINATE for the report is executed, provided that at least one GENERATE statement has been executed for the report since the chronologically last INITIATE'; §2023:14.9.46.4 GR3 c) prints it after the control footings; §2023:14.9.46.4 GR2 'the TERMINATE statement causes no processing of any kind to take place for any report groups' without a GENERATE. The INITIATE-to-TERMINATE interval is already 1985's (§1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2). Same behavior.
